Review of the Kelvaro travel mug, by a verified buyer.

Mixed feelings about this one. It keeps my coffee hot for the whole drive and fits the car's cup holder. But the lid is stiff and hard to open with one hand, which is the whole point of a travel mug. If they fix the lid, I would buy another.
